experiments.description: Consolidate reference evidence; preserve checkpoint and corrected-training comparison tables
Verify eight canonical data hashes, semantics, raw duplicates and missingness
Emit support, verification, source and test ledgers; assert every exclusion and budget
Test support-only transforms, affine inverse, zero counts and common truths
Independently review verifier derivation, filtration, width and decision implementation
Synthetic null/alternative and varying-envelope streams; record calibration and stopping behavior
Model causality, batch invariance and future-label mutation admission checks
One-GPU memory, timing, checkpoint and exact-resume engineering pilot
Persistence on all eight domains; minimum forecast and zero-budget reference
Ridge and compact local models; establish competitive support-only fallback
LLM-UTP shared-data causal adaptation; train before comparing our mechanism
Ordinary Qwen source transfer and identical-verifier control
Full ECTT on all eight domains and seeds 11, 22, 33
Zero, 1, 5 and 10 percent budget curves; preserve infeasibility
Local, unconditional transfer, learned gate and fixed-prefix policies on identical candidate forecasts
Evidence cost, activation, all-test harm and total resource comparison
Gamma-zero objective with the identical sequential verifier
Mean-benefit-only penalty; remove disagreement-envelope contribution
Envelope-only penalty; remove mean-benefit term
Compact nonlanguage backbone with matched learning objectives
Random Qwen initialization with identical frozen/trainable policy
Source-informed and standard sequential alternatives on the same candidates
TESTAM and CompactST official-code eligibility and matched comparison
ST-FGDIR and MURECAST eligibility and matched comparison
FlexST and OpenCity comparison if metadata and training provenance permit
Leave-domain-out evaluation with complete-target and NYC pair exclusions
Leave-mode-out road, metro and NYC demand groups if enough eligible source data remain
Input-node outages at 10, 30 and 50 percent, targets unchanged
History outages of 1, 3 and 6 rows with common masks
Failure analysis by observed flow magnitude, disagreement, evidence length and domain
Matched-regime verification under synthetic outages if making a regime-adaptation claim
Resource Pareto comparison including pretraining, fitting, verification and inference
Multi-horizon prediction after timestamp and delayed-feedback contracts are verified
Prediction intervals with separately budgeted calibration and validity assumptions
Five-seed extension adding 44 and 55 to all primary arms and confirmatory domains

scope: Design documentation only. No new method experiment, inference, dataset download or HPC submission.
next_unit: D01-D03 shared-data preflight; older causal-train3 submission remains on hold.
